title: Sharp Asymptotic Theory of Maximum Likelihood Estimation for Gaussian Processes with a Matern Kernel
abstract: arXiv:2611.29841v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Gaussian processes (GPs) provide a flexible framework for modeling complex dependence structures through a covariance function, or kernel, whose parameters determine the variability, correlation, and smoothness of the underlying process. The Mat\'ern kernel is among the most popular choices due to its flexibility in modeling different degrees of smoothness. Although the identifiability of Mat\'ern kernel parameters under fixed-domain asymptotics is completely understood, identifiability alone does not establish the consistency or asymptotic behavior of the maximum likelihood estimators (MLEs) routinely used in practice. In this paper, we address this gap by developing a sharp asymptotic theory for the joint MLE of Mat\'ern kernel parameters. translated_title: 基于Matérn核的高斯过程极大似然估计的精确渐近理论
translated_abstract: 高斯过程（GP）通过协方差函数（即核函数）为建模复杂的依赖结构提供了一个灵活的框架，核函数的参数决定了潜在过程的变异性、相关性和光滑性。Matérn核因其在建模不同光滑度方面的灵活性而成为最流行的选择之一。尽管Matérn核参数在固定域渐近下的可辨识性已被完全理解，但仅有可辨识性并不能确立实践中常用的极大似然估计量（MLE）的一致性或渐近行为。本文通过为Matérn核参数的联合极大似然估计建立精确的渐近理论来弥补这一空白。由于参数的可辨识性关键取决于观测域的维度，我们刻画了在不同维度下可估计的参数，并建立了它们的收敛速度……
tldr: 本文为Matérn核高斯过程参数的联合极大似然估计建立了精确的渐近理论，刻画了不同观测域维度下可估计的参数及其收敛速度，弥补了从参数可辨识性到估计量渐近性质之间的理论空白。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a sharp asymptotic theory for the joint maximum likelihood estimation of Matérn kernel parameters, characterizing the estimable parameters and their convergence rates under different observation domain dimensions, thereby filling the gap between parameter identifiability and the asymptotic behavior of MLEs.
